articles.title: GTA 6 Players React After Exclusive Shops Greet Non-Ultimate Edition Buyers With Locked Doors
articles.summary: GTA 6 players are being locked out of in-game stores because they don't own the Ultimate Edition, and they've got some thoughts about how Rockstar handled it. We've known for months that the developer's latest sprawling open-world video game would have a $79.99 Standard Edition and $99.99 Ultimate…
body: Rockstar has been clear about what this would mean for standard owners, but in practice, players are feeling like the door has been (literally) closed in their faces. GTA 6's exclusive in-game shops – One-Eyed Willie's, Sara's Unisex Salon, Stock 305, and Electric Fang Tattoo Parlor – are the topic of conversation here. Not everyone was sure how exactly these stores would bar players from entry upon release. It seems, at least based on the consensus from disappointed players, they were expecting to at least be able to enter the locations and not buy anything – but Rockstar doesn't even give them that.

We broke down the Standard vs. Ultimate Edition contents with a side-by-side video that you can check out above. As you can see, the shops have fully decorated interiors that are completely closed off to those who didn't pick up the more expensive version of GTA 6. Those who spent the extra dough can go about their days shopping as they please, while those who didn't have found an unwelcome surprise when heading to any of these spots in Leonida.
points: GTA 6 players are being locked out of in-game stores because they don't own the Ultimate Edition, and they've got some thoughts about how Rockstar handled it.
We've known for months that the developer's latest sprawling open-world video game would have a $79.99 Standard Edition and $99.99 Ultimate…

articles.title: Fallout-Themed AriZona Iced Tea Gets Black Friday Discount, Including New 'Apocalyptic Orange' Flavor
articles.summary: Amazon’s Black Friday sale is officially live, making it a great time to pick up some serious bulk of whatever your drink of choice is. Mine happens to be AriZona Iced Tea, because who can hate cheap caffeine, and I’ll certainly never complain about a deal dropping those prices even further.
body: The 15oz Fallout edition teas only come in 12-can packs, priced at around $2/can. Don’t worry, AriZona still maintains its 99-cent MSRP for non-licensed drinks — founder Don Vultaggio makes sure of that. The Amazon discount only knocks off a couple of bucks, but it brings every Fallout can closer to that beautiful standard price.
The 15% discount is available on 12-can cases of individual flavors as well as the bulk variety pack. All packs have the same base price, so the decision really comes down to your flavor preferences.

Your Fallout options consist of three Vault-Tec reimaginings of AriZona classics – Atomic Red Apple, Wastelander Sweet Peach, and Power Pomegranate – and Apocalyptic Orange, a new flavor unique to the collaboration.

The flavors are tied to specific characters from Amazon’s live-action series, depicted in playing card illustrations on the packaging of each case. Lucy gets apple and the Ghoul gets peach, while Dogmeat and pre-war Ghoul adorn the low-cal versions.

articles.title: GTA 6 Has Dexter References, And Now Dexter Himself Has Reacted
articles.summary: Actor Michael C. Hall has reacted to how GTA 6 features references to his Miami-set TV show Dexter, in which he famously played the serial killer Dexter. Appearing on the Barstool Movies show, Hall said he was "informed" of the Easter eggs in GTA 6 about his character.
body: After the GTA 6 Extended Look premiered in August, people immediately spotted what they thought was Dexter's apartment building from the TV show. Now that GTA 6 has arrived, people found the apartment building in the game, and you can, too, by following GameSpot's Dexter apartment guide here.
On the TV show, Dexter dismembers his victims, stuffs them into garbage bags, and dumps them into the nearby harbor on his boat, the Slice of Life.

Players can also get into a kill house that bears a resemblance to the one that Dexter uses on the show, complete with plastic sheets for the blood splatter, hammers, and cleavers. Players have also found bones underwater, presumably another reference to Dexter.
GTA 6 is full of Easter eggs, so be sure to check out GameSpot's breakdown of GTA 6's best Easter eggs to seek out while you're traveling around Vice City.

articles.title: Jensen Huang Allegedly Threatened Nvidia Workers and Told Employee He Would Rip Off the Top of Their Head and 'Pee on Your Brain'
articles.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang allegedly threatened employees with violence and "humiliated" them for decades. According to sources speaking to The New York Times, Huang — who stepped down as Nvidia's CEO amid a scandal involving infidelity and alleged espionage — has a history of using threatening…
body: Several alleged quotes from Huang are cited in the report, including an incident where Huang reportedly told an employee he wanted to rip their head off and "pee on [their] brain."

In another incident, he is quoted as saying, "You have to do this, or I will rip your f***ing heart out and stomp on it." Others described an incident in which he allegedly went around a room and said he would kill managers, and allegedly said that everyone hoped an employee in their 70s would die soon.

He is also alleged to have told a member of staff: "I’d rather torture you into greatness, because I believe in you." It is further claimed that he described receiving verbal humiliation like this as a "rite of passage" at Nvidia.

This language was described as "foundational" to Huang's style of leadership, and is said to date back to the 2000s. The New York Times said some employees who complained about Huang's behaviour received settlements, and that HR was aware of his alleged behaviour.

articles.title: GTA 6 Sets Even More Records
articles.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally arrived, and, to the surprise of no one, it's putting up some big numbers that speak to the pent-up demand. GTA 6 sold more than 30 million copies and hit almost $4 billion on day one, but that's just the start of understanding the impact of the game's…
body: For starters, the internet service provider Comcast announced that November 18--the final day of preloading--was the busiest day in the company's history in terms of demand. Peak traffic was 31% higher than an average day and a full 9.6% higher that the previous biggest day ever for traffic to Comcast's network.

GTA 6 also now holds five of the top 10 busiest days of Comcast's network of all time. Going further, Comcast said around 24% of all internet traffic on Comcast's network was people downloading or playing GTA 6 on November 18 (no doubt thanks to the New Zealand trick ). Additionally, traffic to Twitch on Comcast's network was up by almost 50% and "is still increasing," Comcast said.

A spokesperson for Comcast further contextualized the traffic data, telling GameSpot that between when preloading began on November 10 and through November 18, PlayStation and Xbox traffic pushed enough data on the network for one million homes to stream The Odyssey in 4K repeatedly for two days straight.
points: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally arrived, and, to the surprise of no one, it's putting up some big numbers that speak to the pent-up demand.

articles.title: GTA 6’s Astonishing $4 Billion Day One Includes 32.5 Million Copies Sold
articles.summary: GTA 6 is an enormous hit--it's the biggest gaming release ever. Take-Two just announced that GTA 6 reach 32.5 million copies sold before release, with revenue reaching $3.79 billion through the end of the first day on sale on November 19.
body: For comparison, 2013's GTA 5 hit $800 million in revenue in its first 24 hours and $1 billion after its first three days, so GTA 6 is pacing well ahead of those numbers. GTA 5 launched at $60, compared to $80 for the cheapest version of GTA 6.

For comparison, the all-time highest-grossing movie ever is Avengers: Endgame, which made $2.94 billion during its entire run. GTA 6 has done nearly $1 billion more in revenue already. According to reporter Jason Schreier, GTA 6 is also now instantly one of the top 30 best-selling games of all time.

Big numbers for GTA 6 were always expected. Sensor Tower had been sharing unofficial sales data for GTA 6 for a long time already, but Take-Two's sales numbers are even higher than the 25 million sales that Sensor Tower reported at launch.

GTA 6 is only going to get bigger when it comes to sales as more and more people buy the game. Additionally, GTA 6 is expected to come to PC in 2027, which will be another selling cycle for the game. Beyond this, GTA 6 is expected to add an online mode in 2027 that will no doubt feature microtransactions and other ways for Rockstar to make money off the fanbase.
points: GTA 6 is an enormous hit--it's the biggest gaming release ever.

articles.title: Who is Johannes Zuch supposed to be in GTA 6?
articles.summary: Everyone is a target in Grand Theft Auto 6. Even Jonathan Blow, the puzzle game designer known for The Witness and Order of the Sinking Star, isn’t safe.
body: It’s a hysterical in-joke for those who are familiar with Blow, but it’s also a shining example of why Rockstar Games is so good at what it does. It’s a studio that fully commits to its bits, even when it means creating a whole game to do so.

Tenebrae Lux only gets more obnoxious (complimentary) from there when you return to it later by playing it in Jason and Lucia’s home. The next major puzzle throws you into a series of looping, nearly identical rooms. You can only escape through a big-brained puzzle that is so unfathomably obtuse that even a thoroughly written guide would sound like gibberish. It’s completely maddening, as Zuch won’t stop prattling on about the Sisyphean hell he’s trapped in while an old-timey sea shanty plays over and over on a crackling record player.

articles.title: GTA 6 Is Crashing On Some PS5s With CE-108255-1 Error Code
articles.summary: After years of waiting, GTA fans can finally play GTA 6, but some players are encountering a dreaded error code that makes the game crash or otherwise fail. Users are reporting receiving the CE-108255-1 error code, which players might see when a game crashes mid-session or fails to load entirely.
body: Sony's official word is that players can try updating their game to fix the issue. If it's really that simple, that would be a welcome result. But people are saying that doesn't always work and are asking Rockstar to put out an official patch.

Reddit user Acrobatic-Promise458 encountered this issue and documented their experience. The person said the game was working normally until they reached a certain point in the story, at which point the game crashes continually. They said Rockstar support directed them to Sony's own support team, but it was no use.
People online ( via Gizmodo ) are theorizing that the crashing issues with GTA 6 on PS5 might be due to the game's intense demands on the hardware, and it could be specifically tied to older PS5s.

Rockstar has yet to officially respond to these reports. Rockstar's official GTA 6 error troubleshooting page isn't much help, as it only links to the support sites for PlayStation and Xbox and offers no specific help. Players can submit a support ticket to Rockstar to get more help with this issue or others.
points: After years of waiting, GTA fans can finally play GTA 6, but some players are encountering a dreaded error code that makes the game crash or otherwise fail.

articles.title: 10 New Movies to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, Prime Video, and HBO Max (November 20 - 22)
articles.summary: Happy weekend! The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping is out in theaters, seemingly putting an end to one of the biggest franchises in recent years. It’s pretty good.
body: If you prefer to stay home, you have plenty of options. Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey is out on VOD and finally available to watch on your TV. The movie stars Matt Damon as Odysseus, following him and his crew of men as they try to return home in the aftermath of the devastating Trojan War.

Other major releases include Steps, Netflix’s latest animated movie, following Cinderella’s evil stepsisters, with one of them forced to team up with her in order to save their realm. It’s voiced by Amanda Seyfried, Ali Wong, Stephanie Tsu, Daniel Radcliffe, and more.

If you’re looking for horror or drama with a healthy dose of disturbing material, Netflix has two options: Insidious: Out of the Further follows a mom plagued by awful nightmares that might be missives from a parallel dimension; Gentle Monste r follows a pianist and a mother who moves to the country with her family looking for a break from city life. Then her husband is accused by the police of serious crimes.

Other horror movies are available on VOD. There’s The Ice Cream Man, following an ice cream seller whose frozen desserts turn kids into killers, and Appofeniacs, a series of horror snippets exploring AI.

articles.title: GTA 6 Players Are Officially Spending an ‘Absolutely Bonkers’ Amount of Time with the Game
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 players weren't kidding about wanting to spend the game's entire launch day in Leonida. Much hullabaloo was made about people requesting time off from work or faking sick to spend the entire day playing GTA 6, and plenty of companies tried to capitalize on that conversation with…
body: Mat Piscatella, senior director at market research firm Circana, shared data on Friday about just how much time players spent with GTA 6 on its launch day, Thursday, Nov. 19. "PS5 GTA VI players averaged 513 minutes that day, Xbox players 494," he said in a post on Bluesky. That's an average of 8.55 and 8.23 hours for PS5 and Xbox players, respectively. That means GTA 6 players effectively spent the length of a workday stealing drugs, beating up rednecks, driving around Fake Florida, kicking bodega cats, and playing GTA 6 's in-game video games.

You could fly from New York City to Seattle in under 8.55 hours. You could watch the entirety of the original Star Wars trilogy in under 8.55 hours. You could binge The Office season 4 in under 8.55 hours. You could finish Resident Evil 2 in under 8.55 hours, and probably still have enough time to finish it again. You could get an honest-to-god good night's sleep for under 8.55 hours, on average. All I'm saying is, 8.55 hours is a long time, especially for an average.
points: Grand Theft Auto 6 players weren't kidding about wanting to spend the game's entire launch day in Leonida.

articles.title: GTA 6 is officially the biggest entertainment launch of all time, selling 32.5 million pre-sale copies and a bonkers $3.79 billion in its first day
articles.summary: Surprise, surprise - GTA 6 is officially the biggest entertainment launch of all time, surpassing its predecessor's 13-year-long record and the already optimistic analyst estimates.
body: Rockstar Games today confirmed that its cultural juggernaut sold a staggering 32.5 million pre-release copies across PS5 and Xbox Series X/S before its official worldwide launch on the 19th of November. By the end of its first day on sale, GTA 6 managed to rake in a frankly absurd $3.79bn. Not a bad haul.
As Rockstar was quick to brag, the whopping performance means GTA 6 set "a new record for entertainment across any medium" by "becoming the biggest entertainment launch in history."

For context, GTA 5 made around $800m in its opening 24 hours more than a decade ago. That mammoth debut almost looks quaint next to GTA 6's stunning numbers, although it's notable GTA 5 didn't launch immediately in Japan or Brazil - GTA 6 is available in almost every market with access to PlayStation and Xbox consoles.

Previous estimates guessed that GTA 6 had sold almost 25m copies ($2.5bn in revenue) on day one. It's fair to say the game's staggering performance blew even those sky-high projections out of the water.
points: Surprise, surprise - GTA 6 is officially the biggest entertainment launch of all time, surpassing its predecessor's 13-year-long record and the already optimistic analyst estimates.

articles.summary: Every week, there are limited-time offers that allow players to enjoy games for free, whether as temporary or permanent additions to their digital libraries. Here's everything that frugal and curious gaming fans can enjoy between Nov. 20 and Nov.
body: Mark of the Deep is free on the Epic Games Store until Nov. 26. It is a Soulslike adventure game where players take on the role of a pirate named Rookie and explore a mysterious island to find the rest of their crew. In their search, they will face a challenging journey filled with all sorts of hostile monsters and a total of 16 bosses.

Hypnospace Outlaw, a 90s internet simulator, was free to play last weekend on Xbox. And this week, gamers can try a spin-off called Slayers X: Terminal Aftermath: Vengance of the Slayer, a game created by Hypnospace Outlaw 's Zane. There are a handful of weapons to try out and lots of fun music to listen to as you blast through enemies in this 90s-themed shooter.

Halloween may have already ended this year, but that doesn't mean the paranormal fun has to. In Polterguys: Possession Party, eight players must possess and sabotage their way to victory by luring opponents into the hands of a deadly monster. It's a unique multiplayer game that guarantees a night of spooky fun among friends.

articles.title: After taking seven years to make Persona 6 and four years to make Persona 5, Atlus promises future games will come quicker
articles.summary: Persona 6 is still slowly chugging in the background, but developer Atlus is promising that future games in its beloved RPG series won't take quite as long as they used to.
body: There was a four year gap between 2012's Persona 4 Golden and the original Persona 5, and it's already been seven years since the expanded Persona 5 Royal first dropped. Despite the sometimes agonising wait filled with countless spin-offs and collaborations with live service games, we've only seen a vague teaser trailer for the next proper Persona.

P-Studio general producer Kazuhisa Wada recently assured folks that the pattern wouldn't repeat again. "Persona 6 is not the end," he said in a Sega Samania interview translated by GamesRadar. "We have been working to make sure that people won't have to wait as long for the next game as they have previously. In order for Persona to grow as an IP, we consider how to live up to people's expectations in terms of creativity and development every day."
points: Persona 6 is still slowly chugging in the background, but developer Atlus is promising that future games in its beloved RPG series won't take quite as long as they used to.

articles.title: GTA 6 credits actually include 'Florida Joker', the viral internet personality who once demanded $10 million from Rockstar Games
articles.summary: Lawrence Sullivan, better known to the online world as the 'Florida Joker', is in GTA 6. After accusing Rockstar Games of using his likeness without consent and then demanding a $10m payout, the two parties have seemingly settled their differences.
body: Grand Theft Auto 6 's earliest controversy came from its very first official trailer, when Sullivan alleged one of the teaser's similarly tattooed characters was modeled after him. The former tattoo model, who first went viral because of a mugshot that shared an uncanny resemblance to Batman's Joker, soon called on Rockstar to pay him $2m. His demand quickly shot up to $10m, before he dropped all legal threats and politely asked to officially work with the developer.
Rockstar seems to have relented to that last request - the vast GTA 6 credits include none other than one Lawrence Sullivan, listed under the 'Local Population' cast, alongside dozens of other names.

GTA 6 players wasted no time, and quickly found the suspect first teased way back in that original 2023 trailer. In its quest to parody all parts of modern life under capitalism, GTA 6 lets you doomscroll through a social media app called Snapmatic, which flings an endless number of short-form clips and thirst traps at you. If you're lucky enough, or if you scroll for long enough, you'll find a video of Sullivan's in-game counterpart beating up a fake lookalike. He certainly sounds like Sullivan, too.
points: Lawrence Sullivan, better known to the online world as the 'Florida Joker', is in GTA 6.
